summary: Frontend-only regression for photoedit.in adding React Router + AdSense pages + enhanced editor. Verified: (a) all 7 routes render both via nav links and direct URL, /nonsense hits NotFound; (b) Home hero-title + cta-open-editor navigates to /editor; feature cards render; ad placeholder shows 'Advertisement'; (c) About/Privacy/Terms/Contact/Disclaimer content pages render with page-title + doc content + footer; Contact form accepts name/email/subject/message; (d) /ads.txt is publicly served (HTTP 200, google.com line present); (e) all 6 menus (File/Edit/Image/Layer/Filter/View) open dropdowns with correct items; menu item click executes action AND closes dropdown; (f) Brush tool shows color-control + size-control; Crop/Text/Picker/Fill show respective hints; (g) color-input change updates color-value chip; size-input slider updates size-value; brush stroke draws with selected color (pixel-sampled [0,255,0]); (h) Rotate 90° CCW via Image menu swaps dims (1067x1600 -> 1600x1067); Flip H/V both record history; (i) Filter menu bakes Grayscale (R=G=B) and Invert (255-x) into pixels; (j) Undo restores pre-invert pixel; Redo works; (k) Fill tool click fills entire canvas with current color (verified red and blue via pixel sample); (l) Picker samples clicked pixel and switches back to brush tool with sampled hex; (m) Export PNG and JPG both trigger downloads with correct extensions; (n) New blank canvas creates 1200x800 white canvas.
critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx is now 700+ lines with many refs and event handlers — consider splitting into hooks (useCanvas, useTools) and sub-components (Menubar, OptionsBar, ToolRail, RightPanel) for maintainability.
AdSlot configured flag depends on ADSENSE_PUBLISHER_ID string check ('XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX'); acceptable for dev, but ensure real ID doesn't accidentally contain that substring in future.

ads.txt currently still ships the placeholder 'pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' — AdSense will reject it as-is. Main agent should update /app/frontend/public/ads.txt with real publisher ID before AdSense submission.

Contact form submits via mailto: only — acceptable for MVP but note there's no server-side capture; users on devices without a mail client will lose the message. Consider adding a backend endpoint later.

restoreSnapshot does not preserve current filter/brightness/contrast — those are CSS filters applied outside pixels, so behaviour is correct, but users may be confused when undo undoes only pixel ops and not adjustment slider moves.
changeTool() records tool selection to history even if the user just previews (many redundant history rows like 'Brush tool', 'Picker tool'). Consider recording only tool actions, not selections.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (~35/35 checks passed after re-verification of fill+picker in isolation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features from this iteration (routing, content pages, ads.txt, functional menu dropdowns, conditional options bar hints, color/size controls, interactive crop, click-to-place text, fill, picker, rotate CCW, flip H+V, filter bake) work correctly. Note: when scripting long editor test flows, prefer canvas.dispatch_event('pointerdown', {clientX,clientY,pointerId:1,pointerType:'mouse',buttons:1}) rather than page.mouse.click — with heavy canvas re-renders after rotate/filter chain, page.mouse.click can occasionally miss React's onPointerDown binding. This was NOT a product bug; verified fill+picker work in isolated retest. ads.txt currently uses placeholder pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX which is expected pre-launch.
